prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
The **best AI video ad maker** depends on your use case, but the strongest “overall” picks in recent reviews are **HeyGen** for avatar-led ads, **Creatify** for ecommerce and UGC-style performance ads, and **Revid.ai** for short-form paid social workflows.[1][3][15]

If you want a single answer:
- **HeyGen** is the best overall if you want **avatar quality + multilingual reach + automated ad creation** in one tool.[1]
- **Creatify** is the best overall if you want **easy product-page-to-video ad creation** and a strong focus on **performance marketing**.[3][12][7]
- **Revid.ai** is the best if your main need is **short-form ad editing and production** for social platforms.[15]

A quick way to choose:
- **Ecommerce/product ads:** Creatify[3][12][7]
- **UGC-style ads:** Creatify or HeyFish, depending on budget and workflow[12][2]
- **Avatar/presenter ads:** HeyGen[1]
- **Budget-friendly all-in-one:** HeyFish or AdCreate[2][6]
- **Short-form paid social editing:** Revid.ai[15]

If you want, I can also give you a **top 5 ranked list by budget**, **best for ecommerce**, or **best free option**.
